description: Core library extracted from llamacpp-ai-index-maven-plugin: routing/configuration model, the .ai.md document codec, the file/package/project indexers, prompt templating support, and the AI generation provider abstraction (incl. the llama.cpp JNI binding). Framework-free (no Maven plugin API); the srcmorph-maven-plugin module supplies only the Mojo entry points on top of this library.
